title: picardDerivedUnitNormalization_comp
statement: Let $W,T,T'$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] with shared derived categories of module sheaves [def-pc-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $i:T'\to T$, $t:T\to W$, $t':T'\to W$ satisfy $it=t'$. Write $O_V=\mathcal O_V[0]$. For $r:V\to W$, let $e_r:Lr^*O_W\cong O_V$ be the canonical single-pullback comparison [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison] followed by the single embedding of $u_r:r^*\mathcal O_W\cong\mathcal O_V$, the adjoint transpose of the unit ring-sheaf map [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $C:Li^*Lt^*\cong Lt'^*$ be derived composition transported along $it=t'$ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Then $Li^*(e_t^{-1})\gg C_{O_W}=s_i(\mathcal O_T)\gg u_i[0]\gg e_{t'}^{-1}$. There is no direct image, coefficient module, fibre product or test section in this assertion; it applies to identities and empty schemes. The displayed construction is named in [def-sc-picard-derived-unit-normalization].

proof.text: Ordinary unit maps compose: transpose pullback(i)(u_t) followed by u_i under the composite ordinary adjunction. The conjugateEquiv equation for pullbackComp and the formulas for the unit maps identify this transpose with the composite ring-sheaf unit map. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence gives pullback(i)(u_t) followed by u_i equals pullbackComp(i,t).hom followed by u_it. This is the calculation underlying the ordinary structure-unit square, performed directly in the private helper.

Evaluate the canonical single-pullback composition equation at O_W. Naturality of its left-derived counit and of the single-complex maps moves the unit morphism u_t through the i single comparison. The ordinary unit equation from the preceding step now gives Li(e_t.hom) followed by the i normalization equals C.hom followed by e_it.hom. Transport along h by equality elimination and cancel the two invertible unit comparisons to get the inverse formula.

theorem picardDerivedUnitNormalization_comp
    {W T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
    (h : i ≫ t = t') :
  let e : ∀ {V : Scheme.{v}} (r : V ⟶ W),
    (derivedPullback r).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace))) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings V.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings V.toRingedSpace)) :=
    picardDerivedUnitNormalization W
  let C := canonicalDerivedPullbackComposition i t ≪≫
    eqToIso (congrArg (fun q : T' ⟶ W ↦ derivedPullback q) h)
  let U := SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)
  (derivedPullback i).map (e t).inv ≫ C.hom.app _ =
    Modules.canonicalSinglePullbackMap i U ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
          (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit i.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫ (e t').inv
